research_question: Which observable ML lifecycle issues are detected beyond plain sklearn numeric validation and evaluation metrics?

scenarios.name: clean
scenarios.ground_truth_scope: No contamination introduced by the experiment

baselines.name: numeric_and_metric
baselines.description: sklearn check_array, feature width, output dimensions/finite values and ordinary metrics; cannot validate provenance

baselines.name: numeric_plus_ids_schema
baselines.description: numeric baseline plus train/evaluation IDs, fit IDs and ordered feature schema, but no numeric row-level duplicate scan

baselines.name: fuzzyxai_ml_observer
baselines.description: read-only structural, source-declaration and observational diagnostics

analysis_constraints: Datasets are limited to sklearn datasets and deliberately introduced faults.
Cross-split exact numerical duplicates are warnings, not verified data leakage.
Missing evidence and not-applicable are separate from factual problems.
No training, repair, or decision is performed by the observer itself.
An experiment fitting faulty models may access evaluation labels solely to demonstrate contamination; performance on those models is invalid as generalization evidence.
The unit of independent evidence is pipeline/dataset; scenarios within a pipeline are dependent.
Record negative controls and all cases, not only detected positive injected faults.
